name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task states only ‘If you move the ball, you must also take the key’ and ‘Then pick up the box in the other room’ – an unconditional hard Existence(target_picked_up). The candidate adds a hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) – ‘If the blocker is moved, the target box must be picked up afterwards’ – which is not stated by the task and makes box pickup conditional on blocker_moved. It also adds a hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) – ‘Pick up the target box only after the key has been taken’ – the task never states an ordering between the key and the box; the environment already guarantees target_picked_up cannot occur before has_door_key via door_open constraints, so the clause is an added requirement for a prerequisite the environment already guarantees. Keep the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) for the conditional and the hard Existence(target_picked_up) for the unconditional goal, and remove the added Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) and the unnecessary Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up).

texts: If the blocker is moved, the matching key must also be taken at some point
Eventually pick up the target box
